description:
Create and configure a community needs assessment survey in LimeSurvey. 

Goal: Create a new survey titled 'Riverside County Community Needs Assessment 2024' and configure it with specific presentation, privacy, and notification settings.

Required Configuration:
1. Title: 'Riverside County Community Needs Assessment 2024'
2. Welcome Message: Must include the text 'Riverside County' AND 'voluntary' (informed consent).
3. End/Description Message: Must include 'thank' AND ('resource' OR 'support').
4. End URL: 'https://www.riversidecounty.gov/community-resources'
5. Presentation: Group-by-group format, Progress bar enabled, Back button enabled.
6. Privacy/Data Policy: Date stamping ENABLED, IP address logging DISABLED, Referrer URL saving DISABLED.
7. Notifications: Set admin notification email to 'dr.martinez@riverside-sociology.edu'.
8. Content: Create at least 2 question groups with at least 1 question in each group.
9. Status: Activate the survey.

Login credentials: admin / Admin123!
